title: Hinomori Shizuku — Lunch Break Study Session〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We made it back in time for afternoon classes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I wasn't sure we would since the meeting ended up being pretty long, but the TV studio was kind enough to call a taxi for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And...I think we have just enough time to eat lunch.
Let's go grab something to eat, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, I'm really sorry, but I still need to finish up the homework for our next class...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please, go on ahead without me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You sure? Do you think you'll be able to finish it on your own?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. It wouldn't mean much if I couldn't, so I'll do my best.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay. Then, I'll get some bread for you if they have any left.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I only have three problems left.
I should be able to finish them in time if I focus...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (For this problem, I should probably draw a graph. Let's see...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This looks correct, but the formula doesn't seem to quite match for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Hi, Hinomori.
Morning... Oh, I guess it's already good afternoon, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, Fukami.
Are you also just coming back from work?

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line: Yeah, we shot two episodes starting at five in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so early.
Was it far away?

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line:
Yeah, two hours by car!
I slept like a baby on the bus, there and back.

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line:
Hm...? Oh, you're doing that problem...
It was definitely the trickiest one from our last homework assignment.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm having some trouble solving it...

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line: Then, I can show you how to do it if you let me see your English notes from yesterday in return.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...? That's really kind of you to offer...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But weren't you in English class yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line:
Yeah, but I wasn't listening at all.
I was working on a survey for a show instead...

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line: So, quid pro quo!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you. This problem really had me stuck.

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line:
Alright, we have a deal!
Can you tell me where you're stuck?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I think it has to do with this formula...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me solve that, Fukami. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line: And I'm all done copying your notes! You're a lifesaver!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, when was the last time I spoke to Fukami like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Actually, I could say the same for most of my classmates...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(We all lead very busy lives.
Even when we are given a break, we usually don't have time to talk since we have homework or other business to take care of...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But that's not a very good excuse, is it...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I should try to get to know my classmates better the way Minori and Haruka have been...)

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm gonna head back to my seat.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: F-Fukami...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku! They still had some rice balls and sandwiches left over!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, so... How would you feel about the three of us having lunch together...?

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line: Huh...? Three? Including me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm fine with that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Did you bring a lunch, Fukami?
If not, please feel free to take a rice ball or sandwich.

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Fukami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I actually brought back a boxed lunch from my shoot.
In fact, how about I share some of my stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure? You're so generous.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's put our desks together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
